# lmLite

> Browser machine learning from Python: run Transformers.js pipelines and bare ONNX models, and reach the microphone and camera, from a Python kernel in JupyterLite (xeus-python or Pyodide). An optional headless onnxruntime backend runs the same ONNX files outside the browser, for tuning.

Notes for using the API:

- The package is `lmlite` on PyPI, with the extras `native`, `images`, `audio` and `camera`. Everything is async: call it with `await`.
- The browser features (`pipeline()`, `LLM`, `Embedder`, `Classifier`, `OnnxModel`, the widgets) need a browser kernel with JavaScript interoperability. Installing the package on a desktop does not run models in a browser; `pip install 'lmlite[native]'` adds a headless backend for `Embedder`, `Classifier`, greedy `LLM.generate()`, `OnnxModel` and `tokenizer()`.
- `from lmlite import pipeline, LLM, Embedder, Classifier, OnnxModel, tokenizer, model_info`. `pipeline(task, model=...)` runs a Transformers.js task (zero-shot classification, translation, speech recognition, audio classification, vision, image-output tasks, text to speech) and has `map()` for many inputs. `LLM.create(generator_model=...)` is for generation, chat and streaming only. `Embedder.create(model)` gives `embed()` and `similarity_search()`; `Classifier.create(model)` gives `classify()`.
- `LLM.create(embedding_model=...)`, `LLM.create(classification_model=...)`, `llm.embed()`, `llm.classify()` and `llm.similarity_search()` are deprecated and will be removed in 0.15.
- Several tested models are non-commercial (see the model guide). Real Safari is untested.

## Guides

- [Run task pipelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decitre/lmlite/main/docs/guides/pipelines.md): `pipeline()`, the task inputs, `map()`, the microphone and camera widgets
- [Generate text and chat](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decitre/lmlite/main/docs/guides/generate-and-chat.md): `LLM`, chat, streaming, token probabilities
- [Embeddings, classification and similarity search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decitre/lmlite/main/docs/guides/embeddings-and-search.md): `Embedder` and `Classifier`
- [Run a bare ONNX model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decitre/lmlite/main/docs/guides/onnx-models.md): `OnnxModel`, NumPy in and out
- [Load only a tokenizer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decitre/lmlite/main/docs/guides/tokenizers.md): `tokenizer()`
- [Models, cache and loading progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decitre/lmlite/main/docs/guides/models-and-cache.md): hosted models, `model_info()`, the cache, ZIP export, `dispose()`
- [Run natively for tuning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decitre/lmlite/main/docs/guides/native-backend.md): the headless onnxruntime backend

## Reference

- [Parameters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decitre/lmlite/main/docs/reference/parameters.md): `LLM.create()`, `Embedder.create()`, `Classifier.create()`, backends and dtypes
- [Pipeline tasks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decitre/lmlite/main/docs/reference/pipeline-tasks.md): each task's arguments and result format
- [Models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decitre/lmlite/main/docs/MODELS.md): the tested model for each task, licences, known failures, hosting models
